simple.meaning: אִילָן (ʼîylân) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a tree.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 4:7. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אִילָן (H363) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אִילָן (ʼîylân) / H363 is traced through Daniel 4:7, Daniel 4:8, Daniel 4:11, Daniel 4:17 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.

timeline.evidenceText: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.
But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods. I told the dream before him, saying,
The tree grew, and was strong, and its height reached to the sky, and its sight to the end of all the earth.

“ ‘The sentence is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones; to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.’
The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

“Whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from the sky, and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.

definitions.full: H363. ilan אִילָן (D 138 ) noun masculine Dan 4:7 tree ( אִילָן ᵑ7 , Syriac ; compare Biblical Hebrew אֵלוֺן אֵלָה, ); — absolute ׳א 4:7 ; emphatic נָא - 4:8 ; 4:11 ; 4:17 ; 4:20 ; 4:23 .
